description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseProvider' implementing common functionality for API providers, including methods for tool schema conversion, token counting, and abstract methods for message creation and model retrieval.

classes.name: BaseProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for API providers, including schema conversion and token counting.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message with a system prompt, messages, and optional metadata, returning an ApiStream.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve model information, returning an object with id and info.

methods.name: convertToolsForOpenAI
methods.description: Converts an array of tools to be compatible with OpenAI's strict mode, handling function tools and MCP tools.

methods.name: convertToolSchemaForOpenAI
methods.description: Recursively converts tool schemas to be compatible with OpenAI's strict mode, adding required properties and handling nested objects.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in content using tiktoken, can be overridden by providers for native token counting.
